title: task-finalization guide: add a clause forbidding rewording an acceptance criterion to fit the evidence
description: opum-doc ruling, ODOC-480 14:03Z, relayed by team-lead. `quest instructions task-finalization` already says "An acceptance criterion you cannot prove stays unchecked, and the reason belongs in the notes". A worker got around it by rewording the criterion. Add one clause there, for example: "Do not reword a criterion to fit the evidence you have; changing what a criterion asks is a ruling, recorded on the task, not part of checking it." Wording is settled within that sense. The right-shaped example is QCLI-539 AC2: amended on opum-doc ruling A with the ruling and its reason recorded in the task notes. Build after PR 691 lands; rides the next quest release. The guide ships inside the CLI (src), so check how the guide text is sourced and whether a test pins it before editing.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The task-finalization guide carries the clause, in the paragraph that says an unprovable criterion stays unchecked
The clause says a changed criterion is a ruling recorded on the task, not part of checking it
Any test that pins the guide text is updated and still passes
